title: Yuuji Yanase, Director of 'Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.', Dies at 59
summary: Yuuji Yanase, the director behind Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni. (In Another World With My Smartphone), died on August 22 due to myocardial infarction. He was 59. A funeral service was held by his close relatives. Animation studio Maho Film announced the news on Wednesday, where Yanase had been a full-time employee since 2023.
